summary: 47-year-old woman from Black Forest swimming in the South Platte River in Eleven Mile Canyon was caught in rapids, swept to an inaccessible spot and tangled in rocks; Lake George Fire Protection District technical rescue lifted her by basket up a steep boulder-lined embankment; treated by Ute Pass Regional Ambulance, then flown by Flight for Life to Penrose Hospital in Colorado Springs.
location: Eleven Mile Canyon (South Platte River), near Lake George
notes: Article gives "Aug. 5" with no year printed; year 2021 pinned parent-side from the article UUID v1 timestamp (created 2021-08-12), validated against Tracy (2019-07-03) and Boreas (2014-03-05) Flume anchors; Aug 5, 2021 was a Thursday. Victim name withheld in source (privacy).
